gate.scene: ACT 1 (মাঠ): one wide dusk-to-night town lane, panned sideways, in layers. A DTR at the lane mouth (shown OFF with a শাটডাউন tag once the permit arrives); 4 PCC LT poles; the fault span between pole 2 and pole 3 with a snapped LT conductor; pole 1 and pole 4 are the 'before and after' earth points. 6 houses with service cables, a meter box on every wall (net meter with Import/Export pages and arrow, or ordinary), green stickers on some boxes, roof panels on some roofs (some only above the parapet), decoy roofs (blue tarp, tanks). 1–2 trees by the span with several branches, maybe one resting on the line. A tea stall where the coworker lurks. The van holds the phone, the PTW book and the file clip. Header: ধাপ · ◆ · 💀 plus a time-of-day game clock. Bottom tray: 10 act tokens (icon + word), same set, same fixed order every play: 'পারমিট' · 'ফিউজ খোলা' · 'আর্থ রড' · 'পোলে ওঠা' · 'ক্যামেরা' · 'তার খোলা' · 'ছাঁটা' · 'জব্দ তালিকা' · 'পুলিশে অভিযোগ' · 'অফিসে রিপোর্ট'. The docket on the van door: 'লাইন ছিঁড়েছে · নথিভুক্ত <day> <time>' (never a deadline). ACT 2 (শুনানি): a CGRF hearing room — company officers on the bench with one neutral member in a different coat, the consumer(s), a bench table, and the player's file as a fan of record cards made automatically by Act 1 acts, each with worker-readable labels and times only ('PTW · কার্বন কপি · 19:40', 'ডকেট স্লিপ · নথিভুক্ত 09:10 · রিপোর্ট 20:55', 'জব্দ তালিকা · <house>', 'অভিযোগ · অফিসারের মাধ্যমে · 21:05', time-stamped photo thumbnails). Guide in a corner throughout; the trainee is LinemanFigure(trainee), gloved.
flow: GuideIntro over the live lane (no start button, a tap does not skip): 'লাইন ছিঁড়েছে, ঘড়ি চলছে — আইন মেনে আলো ফেরান!'

ACT 1 loop: the corner guide asks only for the next step from a tap pool. The player drags any token and drops it on a place (van, pole, house, service cable, branch, trunk, hook). A drop where the act cannot physically happen (e.g. 'ছাঁটা' on a house) slides back with no cost and no verdict. Each act plays as a short animation and costs game minutes: permit trip 20–40 (dealt), fuse 10, earth rod 10, climb + repair 60–90, camera 2, seizure list 10, phone report 5.

Physical acts are judged on the spot (right: sound, praise, ◆, and a reason deck at most 3 times in the field — first solar fuse, the climb, the hook removal; wrong: a slip card or a deadly freeze). Paper acts ('পারমিট', 'ক্যামেরা', 'জব্দ তালিকা', 'পুলিশে অভিযোগ', 'অফিসে রিপোর্ট') are never judged in the field: each drops a record into the file with the same paper sound and is judged at the hearing.

'পারমিট' on the van: the van leaves and returns; a hand passes the signed PTW with its carbon copy and the DTR shows OFF with a tag (the only way the shutdown happens). After a dealt 2–6 game-min from the start the phone lights 'লাইন অফ — উঠে পড়' — sometimes before a fast permit, sometimes after.

Solar: 0–2 solar houses (dealt) with clues only in the world (panels, panels over the parapet via a roof hold, sticker, net meter pages). 'ফিউজ খোলা' on a house pulls its fuse at the pole: solar = right; non-solar = slip on the spot.
Earth: 'আর্থ রড' on pole 1 and pole 4 earths before and after the span; rods on pole 2/3 do not count. A rod dropped before the permit = slip (owner decision).

Climb: 'পোলে ওঠা' on pole 2/3, or 'তার খোলা' on a hook up on the work pole, triggers the climb. Checks: written PTW in the file, both earth ends on, every solar fuse out. Any missing = DEADLY: grey freeze; arc at the pole top (no permit / no earth) or the solar back-feed chain in colour; near-miss/death card and the fall. All present → the crew climbs and repairs (auto cut-scene) → praise → ◆ → reason 'ওঠার আগে কী কী নিশ্চিত করলেন?'.

C1 hooking (~2 of 3 plays): a hook on the LT conductor at pole 2 or 3 down to one house, drawn like a service cable. 'ক্যামেরা' on the hook point records a video with the pole and hook in frame; on the house end it records only a wall and a loose wire end. 'তার খোলা' on the hook (a climb, so climb checks apply) is right only if a pole-hook video already exists; otherwise a slip on the spot. 'তার খোলা' on a normal service cable = slip. 'জব্দ তালিকা' on the hooking house and 'পুলিশে অভিযোগ' on the van phone are the player's to remember (judged at the hearing).

C2 branch (~1 of 2 plays): one branch rests on the span among 2–3 harmless ones. 'ছাঁটা' on it after the permit = right; before the shutdown = DEADLY (owner to confirm, or drop C2); on a harmless branch or the trunk = slip on the spot (the trunk never falls). Leaving the touching branch uncut does not block the repair.

C3 false complaint (~1 of 2 plays, after restoration): a consumer at a lit house (fan turning, meter intact) says his supply has not come back (silent caption). The player may 'ক্যামেরা' the house or meter; nothing judged now.

After the repair the crew comes down, earths come off, the line is restored automatically. 'বাড়ি চলুন' on the van ends Act 1 whenever pressed. 'অফিসে রিপোর্ট' closes the docket with the current time; a report before the repair is a false close judged at the hearing.
Coworker once per play (see coworkerPushBn): the control he would decide calls holdForCoworker() first; never in a praise window; the clock pauses through both beats.

ACT 2: 'শুনানির দিন — আপনার ফাইলই আপনার হয়ে কথা বলবে।' The bench asks 3–4 questions from those the deal and the player's acts made relevant. For each, drag one record card onto the bench table. Right → nod, ◆, reason 'এই কাগজটাই কেন দেখালেন?', zoom, এগিয়ে যান. Wrong record when the right one exists → slip ('এটা এর প্রমাণ নয়'), try again. Right record missing → any drop gets 'এর কোনো প্রমাণ নেই', the bench rules for the consumer, one slip. A question caused by a needless or false act plays as a consequence slip with no drop. Max 1 slip per question.

Result: pass panel (rank unlock and badge per the director's catalog; mark 100 − 15 × slips, pass ≥ 55; 'আজ যা ধরলেন': each act and the record it left) or fail panel. 3 slips → StruckOutCard; a deadly → the fall.

gate.giveawayRisks: Same 10 tokens in the same fixed order, unrelated to any right sequence; all live from the first second, so no unlock signals ready or done. No glow, ring or tick on solar clues, hook or branch; the hook has service-cable line weight. Paper acts give the same sound and a record whether needed or not and are judged only at the hearing; needless ones cost SoP minutes and some create their own complaint (H6, H7). Physical acts are judged on the spot but a wrong one costs a slip or a death. Physical-impossibility bounces show plausibility, not legality. No deadline or countdown anywhere.
